mapper.select: SELECT attribute_id AS attributeId, profile_id AS profileId, attribute_code AS attributeCode, value_text AS valueText, value_date AS valueDate, value_decimal AS valueDecimal, value_vault_token AS valueVaultToken, masked_value AS maskedValue, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_party_attribute WHERE profile_id IN #{id} ORDER BY profile_id, attribute_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_party_attribute(attribute_id,profile_id,attribute_code,value_text,value_date,value_decimal,value_vault_token, masked_value,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{row.attributeId},#{row.profileId},#{row.attributeCode},#{row.valueText},#{row.valueDate},#{row.valueDecimal}, #{row.valueVaultToken},#{row.maskedValue},#{row.createTime},#{row.updateTime}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value_text=incoming.value_text,value_date=incoming.value_date,value_decimal=incoming.value_decimal, value_vault_token=incoming.value_vault_token,masked_value=incoming.masked_value,update_time=incoming.update_time
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_party_attribute WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND attribute_code=#{attributeCode}
